tagline: DNS questions, normal HTTPS traffic ke andar chhupe hue.
description: Normal DNS plain text mein jaata hai, isliye raste mein koi bhi aapka har lookup padh sakta hai. DNS over HTTPS wahi DNS message ek encrypted HTTPS request ke andar rakhta hai, isliye network ko sirf port 443 pe resolver se TLS connection dikhta hai.
legend: Plain DNS (koi bhi padh sakta hai)

normal.name: HTTPS pe example.com ka lookup
normal.summary: Browser apne DoH resolver se example.com maangta hai, TLS ke upar HTTP/2 request ke andar.

steps.title: Port 443 se connect karo
steps.detail: Browser https://dns.example/dns-query use karne ke liye set hai, jo 192.0.2.1 pe hai. Wo port 443 pe TCP connection kholta hai, bilkul kisi bhi secure website ki tarah. Network ko ye normal web browsing ki shuruaat jaisa dikhta hai.

quiz.q: DoH kaunsa destination port use karta hai?
options: 443, kisi bhi HTTPS site ki tarah
quiz.why: DoH bas HTTPS hai, isliye 443 use karta hai. Isse use web browsing se alag pehchanna mushkil hota hai.

steps.title: TLS handshake
steps.desc: Keys agree karo aur certificate check karo
steps.detail: Client Hello TLS 1.3, ek key share aur HTTP/2 ke liye ALPN "h2" offer karta hai. Resolver apne key share se reply karta hai, phir baaki sab, uska dns.example ka certificate bhi, encrypted hota hai. Browser wo certificate check karta hai, isliye raste ka koi fake resolver asli hone ka natak nahi kar sakta.

quiz.q: Is connection ka kaunsa hissa ISP abhi bhi padh sakta hai?
options: Jo names aap lookup karte ho
SNI mein resolver ka name aur uska IP address
quiz.why: Client Hello aur IP header clear text mein hain. ISP ko pata chalta hai ki aap DoH service use karte ho, lekin ye nahi ki aap kya poochte ho.

steps.title: POST /dns-query
steps.desc: DNS message HTTP body ki tarah
steps.detail: Encrypted record ke andar ek HTTP/2 request hai: :method POST, :path /dns-query, content-type aur accept dono application/dns-message. Body example.com type A ki normal DNS query hai, plain DNS jaise hi binary format mein. Uska ID 0 hai, jo caching mein madad karta hai, aur use 128 bytes tak pad kiya gaya hai taaki length se name ka andaza na lage.

quiz.q: Encrypt karne se pehle DNS query ko 128 bytes tak pad kyun kiya jaata hai?
options: Taaki encrypted record ki length se ye andaza na lage ki kaunsa name poocha gaya
HTTP/2 ko tez banane ke liye
Ek UDP packet mein fit karne ke liye
quiz.why: Encryption content chhupata hai, size nahi. Har query ko same block size tak pad karna (RFC 8467) length se guess karne ko rokta hai.

steps.title: Answer aata hai
steps.detail: Resolver example.com ko normal tareeke se lookup karta hai (apne cache se, ya authoritative servers se plain DNS se) aur :status 200, content-type application/dns-message aur cache-control max-age=300 ke saath reply karta hai, jo record ke TTL se match karta hai. Body DNS response hai: example.com A 203.0.113.10, TTL 300.

quiz.q: DNS answer mein TTL 300 hai. HTTP response mein kaunsa max-age hona chahiye?
quiz.why: RFC 8484 kehta hai ki HTTP freshness answer ke sabse chhote TTL se zyada nahi honi chahiye, taaki caches kabhi stale records serve na karein.

steps.title: Compare: plain DNS
steps.desc: DoH ke bina ISP kya dekhta hai
steps.detail: Contrast ke liye, usi laptop ki ek purani app ISP ke resolver ko UDP port 53 pe use karti hai. Uska sawal aur jawab plain text hain, isliye ISP (ya Wi-Fi pe koi bhi) unhe padh, log ya badal bhi sakta hai. DoH mein ISP ne sirf dns.example se TLS connection dekha.

quiz.q: DoH pe switch karne ke baad, kaun abhi bhi dekh sakta hai ki aap kaunsi sites lookup karte ho?
quiz.why: DoH trust ko move karta hai, hatata nahi. Resolver aapki queries decrypt karta hai, isliye jo ise chalata hai us par trust karna padega.

outro.title: Wahi DNS, naya envelope
outro.text: DoH ne DNS ko khud nahi badla: query aur answer ordinary DNS messages hain. Usne bas unhe TLS ke upar HTTP/2 mein lapet diya, isliye network ko aapke lookup kiye hue names ki jagah resolver se ek secure web connection dikhta hai.

blocked.name: Network DoH block kar deta hai
blocked.summary: Office firewall known DoH resolvers ke connections drop karta hai, isliye browser plain DNS pe fall back karta hai.

steps.title: Connection drop
steps.detail: Office firewall ke paas public DoH resolvers ki list hai aur wo unka traffic chupchap drop karta hai, taaki DNS ko khud filter aur log kar sake. Browser ke 192.0.2.1:443 ko gaye SYN ka koi jawab nahi aata; 1 second baad wo phir try karta hai, wahi result.

quiz.q: Traffic encrypted hone ke bawajood firewall 192.0.2.1 pe DoH kaise block kar sakta hai?
options: Wo resolver ke IP address aur SNI se block karta hai, jo visible hain
quiz.why: Encryption content chhupata hai, ye nahi ki packets kahan jaa rahe hain. Well-known resolver IPs aur names block karna aasaan hai.

steps.title: Plain DNS pe fall back
steps.desc: Page phir bhi load hota hai, privacy nahi
steps.detail: Apne default mode mein browser DoH ko best effort maanta hai. Resolver tak na pahunch paaye to wo us DNS server pe fall back karta hai jo network ne diya, UDP 53 pe. Lookup chal jaata hai, lekin ab firewall har name padh sakta hai.

quiz.q: User ne "maximum protection" (strict DoH, no fallback) chuna hai. Yahan kya hoga?
options: Names resolve nahi honge, isliye pages load nahi honge
Browser port 53 DoH pe switch karega
quiz.why: Strict mode names leak karne se mana karta hai, isliye DoH blocked hone par lookup fail ho jaata hai. Privacy chalne se upar hai.

steps.title: Canary domain
steps.desc: "Yahan DoH nahi" kehne ka shaleen tareeka
steps.detail: Firefox network ke resolver se ek special name use-application-dns.net bhi poochta hai. Jo network DNS answers filter karna chahta hai wo uske liye NXDOMAIN deta hai, aur browser us network pe DoH ko default se off rakhta hai, timeouts ka intezaar kiye bina.
facts: DoH ko default se on mat karo
Start pe aur network change pe

outro.title: Blocked, phir fall back
outro.text: DoH ye chhupata hai ki aap kya poochte ho, ye nahi ki kisse poochte ho. Network well-known resolvers block kar sakta hai ya canary domain se signal de sakta hai, aur browser phir plain DNS pe fall back karta hai jab tak user ne strict mode na chuna ho.
facts: Leak karne ki jagah fail hota hai
